delivered.body: Confidential Settlement Agreement This document contains confidential information intended for the exclusive use of the parties involved. Unauthorized disclosure is prohibited. RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims. 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff a total settlement amount (the "Settlement Amount") agreed upon by both parties, which shall be specified in a separate annex. 2. RELEASE. Upon payment, Plaintiff releases all claims against Defendant. 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential. 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
